'''Carlon Brandes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SWI145" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> He shared his surname<ref name="SWI145" /> with [[Hela Brandes/Legends|Hela Brandes]], who served as the [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] sitting on the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]] during the first term of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] reign.<ref name="TPMv">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brandes was first identified in [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery: Naboo's Finest!'']], an article written by [[Tim Veekhoven]], [[Kevin Beentjes]] and [[Sander de Lange]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 145|145th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="SWI145" /> The character was given the surname Brandes to establish a link with Hela Brandes, a background character from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. More specifically, Veekhoven, Beentjes and de Lange intended Carlon to be Hela's son.<ref name="FB">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-naboos-finest-rogues-gallery-star-wars-insider-145/630688876981223|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Oct 22, 2013|archivedate=20200412203331}}</ref>
